description: read_file resolves the path with resolve(root, path) instead of inside(root, path, repo), so ../ and absolute paths read outside the repo
write_file confines paths to the repo instead of .verdict/, so the planner can overwrite src files
run's sandbox Box makes the real repo writable alongside the scratch copy

edits.find: const box = sandboxed(argv, { readable: [copy, repo], writable: [copy], network: false }, dir);
edits.replace: const box = sandboxed(argv, { readable: [copy, repo], writable: [copy, repo], network: false }, dir);

description: claude-code.ts turns Claude Code's built-in tools (Bash, Read, Edit…) on with the claude_code preset instead of tools: [], so the agent can read and write outside the repo

edits.find: tools: [], // no built-in tools: only verdict's
edits.replace: tools: { type: "preset", preset: "claude_code" }, // Claude Code's own tools alongside verdict's
